Post 1

New 20-day high, then a retreat. ASX 200 closed at 8,816.90, down 28.80pts or 0.33%. Energy and Materials sold off hard while defensives caught a bid. The index gave back the milestone but held its 5-day gain of 0.38%. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2

📉 Energy -1.31%, Materials -1.16% led the selling. Consumer Staples flipped the script, gaining +1.14%, with Health Care +0.87% close behind. Rotation into defensives was the clearest signal of the day. #ASX #energy #healthcare #ausbiz

Post 3

🔺 Cochlear surged +5.17% to AUD 139.40, adding AUD 6.85 in a single session. COH was the standout large-cap move, pulling Health Care higher and giving the sector real conviction on an otherwise cautious day. #ASX #healthcare #ausbiz

Post 4

🪙 Gold at AUD 5,932.57/oz with AUD/USD at 0.6995. Silver AUD 82.29/oz. Precious metals holding firm even as Materials stocks sold off — a disconnect worth watching if the sector stays under pressure. #gold #silver #commodities #ASX

Post 5

Energy -1.31% two sessions running. Watch whether crude stabilises overnight. If Materials stay offered with gold above AUD 5,900/oz, the defensive rotation has legs. Does this week close above 8,816 or does the new high fade? Drop your call. #ASX #ausbiz #gold
